title: Here’s What’s Leaving HIDIVE in September 2026
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is only a month away, and it’s going to be another exciting quarter for fans. With the return of major shows such as Black Clover and The Apothecary Diaries , the schedule is already packed, and more will be announced at a later date.

title: Final Fantasy Resonance Game Reveals Sephiroth, Demo
content: Square Enix unveiled during Sony 's State of Play livestream on Thursday a trailer for Final Fantasy Resonance , a new HD-2D offline game based on the first story arc of the defunct Final Fantasy Brave Exvius smartphone game.

title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance Game Expansion's Trailer Introduces Gundoraja
content: CAPCOM revealed during Sony 's State of Play on Thursday the first trailer for the upcoming Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance expansion for its Monster Hunter Wilds game, and it teases a new Elder Dragon Gundoraja. The Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance major expansion will launch in 2027.
